purpose: Named memory-preset profiles. Each 'overrides' maps params-schema ids -> values and is applied on top of the base config before launch. The GUI offers these as one-click presets next to the parameter panel; the core applies them by rendering each param's 'flags'. Add new presets as one row here - no code change.
notes: Light-memory tools available in this fork: asymmetric KV (cache_type_v=q4_0), moe_expert_placement=frequency (hot experts), moe_gpu_expert_ratio, cpu_moe / n_cpu_moe, moe_gpu_expert_slot_num, shorter context.
frequency placement = keep the frequently-picked ('hot') experts on GPU and the rest on CPU. Lower moe_gpu_expert_ratio = lighter on VRAM.

presets.label: Very light (tiny VRAM)
presets.description: Extreme memory saving: asymmetric KV, short context, hot-expert frequency placement at 20%, minimal prompt cache.

presets.label: Light (balanced saving)
presets.description: Moderate memory saving: asymmetric KV, hot-expert ratio 50%, medium context.

presets.label: Balanced (default)
presets.description: Good default: q8_0 KV, all experts on GPU, auto offload, standard context.

presets.label: Full quality
presets.description: Maximum quality: high-precision KV, all experts on GPU, larger context, flash attention on.

presets.label: MoE on CPU (big model)
presets.description: For very large MoE models: keep MoE weights in CPU and use routing-aware slots to limit GPU memory.

presets.label: Spec decode: MTP
presets.description: Enable speculative decoding with the model's built-in MTP head (needs a combined *_MTP.gguf).

presets.label: Spec decode: Eagle3
presets.description: Enable Eagle3 speculative decoding with an external draft model.
